items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 August 2026 10:17pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 15 August 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge from the Azores High to the northwest of Scotland.


##Wind##

Mainly northwest 3 or 4, but variable in places becoming variable 3 or less in all water overnight. Settling mainly west or southwest 3 or 4 late morning tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then outbreaks of rain developing later in the night and tomorrow morning, then becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate in places overnight & tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, backing mainly south or southwest Monday evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Occasional patchy light rain, becoming more persistent Monday evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
